rows.en:
"..........☆"
{f:Good God|Oh no}, heads were hanging all across the ceiling, {f:staring right at me|and they were staring at me}!
The heads covering the ceiling squirmed, desperately pleading for something, on and on.
The heads on the ceiling dropped to the floor and burst.
So many fell that they covered the whole floor.
And still the ceiling was covered with hanging heads.
The heads on the floor came inching toward {f:me|me} and Hosoda, scraaape... scraaape...
The heads that crawled up {f:my|my} body kept climbing, higher and higher, toward {f:my|my} face.
My heart was about to burst{f:.|.}{p}

"Oh, so you do?
Yes, I thought so, I thought so.
Wow, that's {a}{f:|} for you.
Actually, I can sense it too.
Oh, and everyone.
I'm terribly sorry, but could you leave me alone here with {a}{f:|}?
No, it's not that I think of you as being in the way.
I just think it'll be easier to sense the spirits if it's only {a}{f:|} and me.
I'd appreciate your cooperation, everyone."{p}
Everyone grumbled as they went out.{p}

Inside a stall would be too obvious...
I know, I'll say the urinal.
It might be fun to name the least likely place of all.
{f:I|I} put on the most serious face I could and muttered,
"...There.
That urinal there..."{p}

"Ah, {f:I|I} can see it!
There's a person's face reflected in the urinal.
Oh, how frightening.
Blood is running down that face!"
Hosoda was peering into the urinal, trembling all over.
"{a}{f:|}, I can't see anything..."
This is why I can never give up pranks.
Something about this guy {f:just grosses me out on a gut level|is so weird}, so {f:I'll tease him for all he's worth|maybe I'll tease him for all he's worth}.
"Ah, look out!
A hand is coming out of the urinal, trying to grab you, Hosoda!"{p}
"Huh★ A hand★"
Hosoda suddenly went pale and shot out of the restroom like a released spring.{p}

It was all {f:I|I} could do to keep from laughing.
It was exactly like poking a needle into a balloon blown up until it was ready to pop.
But why was he so scared, {f:I wonder|I wonder}?
Does he have some bad memory about 'hands'?{p}

"{f:Whoa|Eek}!"
{f:I|I} lost my balance and fell flat on my backside.
"{f:Ow, ow, ow|Ouch, ouch}... Huh?"
As I tried to get up, I thought I saw something strange out of the corner of my eye.{p}

Right beside {f:my|my} face, as I sat there on the floor, was a urinal.
I thought I'd seen a person's face inside it{f:.|.}
{f:I|I} was so startled I nearly jumped out of my skin.
My knees suddenly began to shake, and my teeth wouldn't stop chattering.
What {f:was|was} that just now?
{f:I|I} was just making that up{f:|}★
I tried to look once more to make sure, but I didn't have anywhere near the courage to peer into the urinal.
Wait{f: a second|}.
There was supposed to be no one in this restroom but {f:me|me}{f:.|.}
...Then who pulled {f:me|me}...?
Sweat burst out all over my body.{p}

Blood began to run from {f:my|my} face reflected in the urinal.
"{f:Wh|Ee}-{f:whoaaaaaa|eeeeeek}!"
As I stood up to run, {f:I|I} was seized by something again.
That invisible something grabbed {f:my|my} neck from behind and, with unbelievable strength, tried to press {f:me|me} against the urinal.
Little by little, the urinal drew closer.
A sharp, stinging smell hit my nose.
{f:My|My} face reflected in the urinal was grinning.
The tip of my nose was about to touch the bowl{f:.|.}{p}

"Mmph!"
Pressed against the urinal, {f:I|I} ended up looking as if I were kissing my own face reflected in the bowl.
Pinned down like that, my nose hurt as if it would break.
{f:I wanted to call for help, |No... }{f:but when I opened my mouth, |help me... }{f:only salty-tasting water poured in, |why do I have to go through this }{f:and I couldn't make a sound.|in the boys' restroom, of all places?}
"Ugh... gack..."
{f:I|I} couldn't breathe, and I writhed in agony.
Just then, by a stroke of luck, the tip of my foot hit a bucket that had been left in the restroom.{p}

"Hey, what happened?"
The senior who'd rescued {f:me|me} asked.{p}

I just kept coughing and couldn't answer at all.
"Well, well, you've got some unusual tastes.
I've never heard of anyone who likes licking toilets.
Alright, from today on, you're Mr. Toilet-Licker."
...What's so 'alright' about it...
Somebody was spouting idiotic nonsense, but I didn't even have the strength to get angry.{p}

"That's strange.
That can't be right.
I know! If we don't go inside, we won't sense anything, even what's there to sense, right?

{a}, let's go into the restroom together.
It's fine.
This is for an interview, after all.
I don't think anyone will blame you for going into the boys' restroom.
Oh, excuse me.
Would the rest of you mind waiting outside?
We'd like to be alone, just the two of us.
If anything happens to us, I'd like you to come in and help.
Well then, thanks in advance."
Wait a minute. What does he mean, he wants to be alone with me?
What if he tries something weird?
Hosoda does have that kind of vibe about him.
Ignoring my worries, the seniors went out with sour looks on their faces.{p}

"Now, {a}.
We're finally alone together."
Give me a break...
"Well? Now that we're inside, you can feel it, can't you?
That powerful aura..."
Hosoda's forehead was beaded with sweat.{p}

"Somehow I get a bad feeling from inside the stall at the very back."
He went into that stall and started examining something.
Though how exactly do you examine something you can't even see?
"Hmm, there does seem to be something here."
Hosoda murmured, still inside the stall.
"H-huh...?"{p}

The moment he said that, Hosoda came rushing out of the stall.
"What's wrong, Hosoda?"
Hosoda's body suddenly began to shake.
This was no ordinary trembling.
His whole body heaved in waves; it was anything but normal shaking.
"Hosoda! Hosoda!"{p}

Shaking violently, Hosoda collapsed on the spot and stopped moving.
Even when I shook him, there was no response at all.
What should I do...?
That's it, the seniors outside...{p}

I started to go call the seniors waiting outside.
Just then, Hosoda let out a groan.{p}

"Graaagh!"
Hosoda let out a roar like a wild beast and, with unbelievable speed, cut around in front of me.
His eyes had rolled back, showing only the whites.
"Eek!"
I ran, desperate to get away from Hosoda.
Hosoda thrust both hands out in front of him and slowly came toward me.
"Hosoda, Hosoda, pull yourself together!
It's me, it's {a}!"
"...{a}..."
For an instant, Hosoda stopped moving.
Maybe it was my imagination, but his voice sounded different somehow.
"That's right. It's me. It's {a}."
Hosoda's eyes were twitching, as if in spasms.{p}

Then his eyes snapped wide open, and his eyeballs, now turned a deep blood red, rolled back around to face front.
He was like a completely different person from the Hosoda who was always smiling.
"Urk..."
Suddenly Hosoda grabbed me by the neck and began to strangle me with unbelievable strength.
I was lifted up, both feet dangling in the air.
"Kh... kh..."
I couldn't breathe in or out.
"You... I hate you... I hate you!"
Hosoda kept repeating it in a voice that seemed to echo up from the depths of the earth.{p}

"☆"
Someone was standing behind Hosoda.
I couldn't tell who, but it looked like a man.
He was muttering something.
"Kill... I'll kill you..."
...I can't... take any more. I'm losing consciousness...
With the last of my strength, I thrashed about.
Even so, his grip didn't budge an inch.
My eyes were open, yet everything in front of me was going dark.{p}

I'm... going... to die...
The moment I thought that, I swung my head with all my might without even thinking.{p}

The window glass right behind my head shattered.
Then a gust of wind blew in from outside.{p}

In that instant, the strength suddenly drained out of Hosoda, and I collapsed on the spot.
Hosoda just stood there, staring blankly ahead.{p}

"What's going on★"
The seniors who had been waiting outside heard the glass break and came rushing in.
"Cough, cough..."
On all fours, I clutched my throat, coughing.
Hearing the seniors' voices, Hosoda came back to his senses and turned around.{p}

"You! What did you do to {a}?!"
The senior who'd burst in rounded on Hosoda and grabbed him by the collar.
"I-I don't know, I don't know! I don't remember anything!"
Hosoda had gone pale and was desperately denying it.
"N... no, it's not like that... Cough."{p}

Coughing, I explained to the seniors what had just happened.
"A man was standing there...?"{p}

"Yes..."
Just as I said that, a groaning, indescribable voice suddenly echoed through the restroom.
"Whoa!"
"What was that?"
"Eeeeek!"{p}

Everyone panicked and ran out of the restroom, fleeing as fast as they could.
Dragged along by the seniors, I somehow managed to escape too.
"Hah, hah, hah... What... was that just now..."
"Hah, hah, hah... I don't know..."
Everyone was gasping for breath.{p}

"Hah, hah... {a}..."
Hosoda brought his face close to mine.{p}"I, um, I kind of need to go to the toilet..."
Stop him
Don't stop him

"...I see.
Well then, we'll wait for you in the club room."{p}

Surely he isn't going back to that restroom from before...
We parted ways with Hosoda and went back to the club room.{p}

..........
..........
For a long time, no one said a word.
The air felt stretched tight.
I wish I'd never taken on this job...{p}

Maybe he was cold; he sat hunched up small, shaking violently.
"...I've heard about this.
A story about a man's ghost that appears in a restroom at this school...
So that restroom was the one."
After a while, one of them murmured it quietly.
"What do you mean★"
My voice came out harsher than I meant it to.
"You don't have to get so angry!
Everyone's on edge as it is."
"I'm not angry, I just..."
I faltered as I answered.
"Sigh... Like I said, I've heard about it.
A story about a man who appears in a restroom.
The older girl who lives next door to me told me.
She graduated from this school too.
She said there's a restroom where a man appears, though she didn't know why."
"Why does he appear?
...And who is he?"
"...I don't know.
All I ever heard was that there's a restroom where a man appears...
But apparently he's been appearing ever since this new school building was first built."
"I see..."
I looked down.{p}

"Um... {a}.
I don't remember anything from back then...
I didn't do something bad to you, did I...?"
Hosoda asked me apologetically.
He had become completely meek.
So meek I could hardly believe he was the same person who had attacked me earlier.
"...No, I'm fine. Please don't worry about it."
Seeing Hosoda so pale, curled up small and trembling, I couldn't bring myself to tell him the truth.
"...I see. Thank you."
Still, Hosoda seemed to sense, vaguely, that he had been violent with me.
Even so...
Is Hosoda really all right?
If it turns out he went and got himself possessed by a spirit again, there'll be nothing we can do.
What if he's only pretending to be meek and goes berserk on the way home?
Well, I don't think that will happen, but...{p}

"Hey, so what now?
Are you still going to keep the stories going, even after something like this?"{p}One of the senior boys asked me.
Continue
Stop here

"No, let's continue.
We can't let something like this beat us.
Besides, we have to make this project a success, so that no one else ever has to go through something like this again."
With fresh determination, I resolved to continue the stories.
"Now then, sorry to keep you waiting.
Next is.........."{p}

"...Hosoda, don't you think you'd better not?
Not after what just happened."
"But I can't hold it in.
{a}, you and the others can go back to the club room.
I'm just going to run over there real quick."
Without waiting for an answer, Hosoda dashed off.
In the end, we went back to the club room ahead of him...{p}

"Um... I've realized this project is far more serious than I imagined.
It's already gone well beyond what I can deal with.
I'm terribly sorry, but this is more than I can handle.
...Besides, if we keep going, you might all be put in danger.
If that happened, I'd be responsible...
So I've made up my mind to call it off here..."{p}

It was right as I said that.
Suddenly, the whole room began to shake!
"Whoa, what's happening?"
"Eeeeek!"
"Wah, wah!"{p}

The shaking suddenly stopped.
"What the heck was that? An earthquake?"
"But the shaking felt different somehow."
..........{p}

"...Maybe the spirits are angry..."
Hosoda muttered under his breath.
"That's it, the spirits are angry.
Because we tried to stop telling the stories..."
Hosoda said it, shaking violently.
"Oh, we can't stop.
We've been cursed.
I'm sure of it.
We've made every spirit in the school angry.
...I wanna go home.
I wanna eat dinner.
I wanna eat the dinner my mommy makes..."
Hosoda was mumbling in a voice like he might burst into tears at any moment.{p}

"...Looks like we've got no choice but to go on."
".........."
Is Hosoda right?
If he is, what will happen when all the stories are over?
Will we come out of this all right?
Still, for now, it seems best to keep the stories going.
No matter what waits for us at the end...
"...Everyone, let's continue.
I don't know what will happen from here on, but it seems we have no choice but to keep going for now.
However, let me say just this.
Whatever happens, you'll have to take responsibility for yourselves.
Please look after your own safety."
..........
"Since no one seems to object, I'd like to carry on as we are.
Now then, let's move on to the next person.
Next is..."{p}

"You don't need to worry about {f:me|me}.
More importantly, let's hurry back to the club room and carry on.
...There are still two people left..."
Out in the hallway, Hosoda was watching {f:me|me} with a pale, worried face.{p}

Ah, I see!
You sense it, don't you?{p}
